preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of '0' and '1'.
The length of the input string is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of awesome substrings is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(stdin)) for j in range(i+1, len(stdin)+1) if '1' in stdin[i:j] and len(stdin[i:j]) % stdin[i:j].count('1') == 0)
postconditions.description: The output is the count of awesome substrings of the input string.
